_about: Default network addresses (LAN as of 2026-10-16, after the router reset). Server > Set IP saves your own copy in the client data folder (see Code/paths.py).

client._about: This Windows PC. For reference only; the client never needs its own IP.

avatar._about: The 3D model (ChatUIAvatar, Unity) on this PC: its Avatar Api Server. Chats with "3D model" on drive it.

nas._about: Samba NAS. Chats, sections, links, projects and personalities are saved in save_path on it: //ip/share/save_path on Windows, mount/save_path on Linux (Code/paths.py).
